title: Kairos Health Helps Dental Practices Turn Patient Follow-Ups Into Scheduled Appointments
html:
Kairos Health, a Y Combinator-backed company, offers AI voice agents that help dental practices follow up with patients, manage incoming calls, and fill their schedules.

Kairos’ outbound agents contact patients about unscheduled treatment, overdue hygiene visits, missed appointments, and returning to care. Practices can customize outreach through coordinated phone calls and text messages, with multilingual support, including English and Spanish (and many more). The agents help patients schedule directly into the practice’s management system, reducing the manual follow-up work required of front desk teams.

Kairos also offers an inbound AI receptionist that answers calls around the clock, including during busy office hours, evenings, and weekends. It can answer common questions, schedule appointments, and transfer calls to the practice when staff assistance is needed.

The idea grew out of co-founder Adhira Tippur’s experience watching her mother, a general dentist in South Texas, manage the demands of patient communication across her practices. Kairos was built to help dental teams stay connected with patients while giving staff more time to focus on those in the office.

Practices interested in learning more can contact adhira@kairoshealthai.com or visit the website is: kairoshealthai.com/
